**2B.4 Research Note: Vladimir Putin in 2024**

Bottom line: the 2024 record is **strongly against** respect for civilian protection, humanitarian law, prisoner treatment, necessity, and proportionality. I found only one weak, indirect pro-side item: a Kremlin decree tightening military discipline and incident reporting. The stronger evidence is repeated UN reporting on POW abuse and civilian harm, plus Reuters reporting on alleged child transfer.

| Direction | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| Slightly for 2B.4 | `Указ Президента Российской Федерации от 01.03.2024 г. № 162` | Kremlin | 2024-03-01 | https://www.kremlin.ru/acts/bank/50378/print | Putin amended military statutes to require commanders to prevent crimes and incidents, report problems promptly, respond to weapons-storage alarms, and define actions for nuclear, chemical, and biological attack scenarios. This is the only 2024 evidence I found that points toward procedural discipline and incident prevention, but it is broad military governance, not a clear humanitarian-law commitment. | 2B.4, 1B.3, 1B.7 |
| Against 2B.4 | `UN says Russia continues to torture, execute Ukrainian POWs` | United Nations in Ukraine | 2024-03-26 | https://ukraine.un.org/en/264368-un-says-russia-continues-torture-execute-ukrainian-pows | The UN human rights mission said almost every interviewed POW described torture, with more than half reporting sexual violence. This is direct evidence against humane prisoner treatment and against respect for IHL. | 2B.4 |
| Against 2B.4 | `Ukraine human rights situation remains bleak three years after Russia’s full-scale armed ...` | United Nations in Ukraine | 2024-12-31 | https://ukraine.un.org/en/286771-ukraine-human-rights-situation-remains-bleak-three-years-after-russia%E2%80%99s-full-scale-armed | The UN said the situation remained bleak, with rising civilian casualties, continued executions and torture of POWs, and efforts to entrench control in occupied territory. This is strong late-year evidence that Putin’s war posture did not respect civilian protection or proportionality. | 2B.4 |
| Against 2B.4 | `Exclusive: Putin-controlled aircraft deported Ukrainian children, US-backed research alleges` | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-12-03 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/exclusiveputincontrolled-aircraft-deported-ukrainian-children-usbacked-research-alleges-3750835 | Reuters reported Yale researchers’ allegation that Russian presidential aircraft and funds were used in a child-transfer program. This is not a judicial finding, but it is relevant evidence against civilian protection if accepted as true. | 2B.4 |
| Against 2B.4 | `Russia to practice tactical nuclear weapon scenario to deter West` | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-05-06 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/russia-to-practice-tactical-nuclear-weapon-scenario-to-deter-west--defence-ministry-3419973 | Russia announced tactical nuclear deployment drills after claiming Western threats. While not an IHL case by itself, it reflects a wartime posture centered on coercion and escalation rather than proportional restraint. | 2B.4, 1B.5, 1B.8 |
| Against 2B.4 | `Russia begins second stage of tactical nuclear weapon drills with Belarus` | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-06-11 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/russia-begins-second-stage-of-tactical-nuclear-weapon-drills-with-belarus-3478894 | Reuters reported a second drill phase with Belarus to practice tactical nuclear deployment. This shows sustained escalation and operationalization in the war, not careful limitation to defensive necessity. | 2B.4, 1B.5, 1B.8 |

**Synthesis**

- Best-supported answer: **No**. The 2024 evidence points strongly against respect for civilian protection, prisoner treatment, and proportionality.
- The strongest evidence comes from **UN reporting** on torture, executions, and worsening civilian harm.
- The only pro-side item is a **procedural discipline** decree, but it does not offset the repeated abuse findings.
- Search gap: I did **not** find credible 2024 evidence of Putin publicly enforcing humanitarian-law compliance, improving POW treatment, or constraining operations on proportionality grounds.
